$comment: The web validator (app/web/src/lib/protocolValidator.ts, as of a03fce8, before it moved to the core) output in English for every library entry and a corpus of violations of each check, with `limits` either empty or a strict set. `expected` is the issue list with the per-call id dropped; texts are the English the locale keys resolve to, so the core (which returns keys) is compared after resolving them against locales/en.json. Frozen: regenerate only from a reviewed validator change. The strict limits set's level is 'global': the web validator attributed every configured limit to 'global' whatever the level, and the core attributes it to the level (or a per-field map), so the two agree there. `limits` names one of the sets in the top-level `limits`, and `allProtocols` is null, a list, or "library" for the shared `library` list, so the file does not repeat them in every case. One deliberate edit to the web output: the cervical-VNS `Configured / Max Ns` warning, which fired whenever a session-duration limit was set whatever the value, is retired; the real check (the on-interval against the limit) replaces it.
